data.long_meaning: Gracielita is a diminutive form of the Spanish name Gracia, which means 'grace'. The name is often given to girls to reflect the grace and beauty of the Virgin Mary. The name Gracielita carries the meaning “Little grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gracielita usually hope their child will grow to embody little grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gracielita total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
